title: Luxury Skyline Rooftop Hot Tub | 4 miles to DT
description:
Luxury meets convenience—Just 3.8 miles from Broadway! This designer 4BR/4BA home features a private rooftop hot tub with stunning skyline views, 2 elite King suites, 1 Queen suite with premium Sleep Number beds, and a custom triple bunk. Perfect for groups, you’ll love the open chef’s kitchen and sleek lounge space. Nestled near Germantown and Nissan Stadium, it’s the ultimate upscale home base for your Nashville getaway

The space
Experience the absolute best of Music City from this designer 4-bedroom retreat! Whether you're soaking in your private rooftop hot tub with sweeping downtown views or gathering around the open-concept chef's kitchen, this home is engineered for premium group luxury. Nestled in a quiet, upscale neighborhood just a quick rideshare from Broadway, you get the perfect blend of thrilling Nashville energy and serene comfort.

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
BetterBNB guests enjoy exclusive VIP discounts on luxury chauffeur transportation and lake boat rentals! House Rules & Details: Must be 21+ to book. No parties, unregistered guests, or smoking allowed on the property. Quiet hours are observed from 10 PM to 8 AM out of respect for neighbors. Keyless entry details are sent prior to arrival. We look forward to hosting your Nashville trip and making it an unforgettable stay!
